evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Customer mentioned bunk bed and boxes; Joanna asked 'aside from the pricing, do you have any other imported concerns' but this is not the two-concerns script about on-time guarantee and damage protection.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by customer in response to Joanna's generic concerns check.

top_strength: Joanna gathered logistics details methodically (addresses, property type, floors, elevator access, furniture and box count) and delivered a clear, itemized estimate with hourly rate, minimum, and included services all transparent.
coaching_note: Ask the two-concerns question before any probing (damage and on-time reliability), then deliver both promises with permission language and close the loop — this earns trust early; separately, end with a direct ask for the business backed by rate-lock language, never hand off to email as a soft out.
